reason: Directly explains the regional variation via STC 61/1997, art. 148.1.3 CE and the basic-legislation role of RDLeg. 7/2015, which is exactly what was asked.

Declares the material silent and refers to a lawyer while the vocabulary lists ejecución subsidiaria, and fills the rest with AFO status and appeal routes that do not address whether the council can demolish and bill.

Applies the interest-plus-repairs cap to the figures (26,900 minus 9,000 = 17,900 carried forward 4 years), though it opens with a copied section header and pads with depreciation and IBI points nobody asked about.
Lists the prior authorisation, the 6-month silence-equals-refusal rule, the 10% levy and the separate building and activity permits, which answers what else is needed.
The material has no contract template, so declining to draft while outlining the essential elements, perfection and hidden-defects deadline is a fair response rather than a dodge.
Subtracts machinery, takes 10% of 2,790,000 and gives 279,000 euros, exactly the computation the question asked for.
Applies the 3% ajuar rule to 397,000 euros and gives 11,910 euros, addressing the question in Polish from the material.
A real attempt that quotes the 10-dwellings-or-1,500 m2 threshold and applies it to the asker's figures, even though it misreads 1,700 as below 1,500 and restates the conclusion several times.
Applies the 3% household-goods rule to 892,000 euros and gives 26,760 euros, with only mild restatement of the rule.
Picks the Andalusian reduced AJD rate for habitual residence under 150k and computes 940 euros on 94,000, with the VPO and VAT remarks as minor add-ons.
